prerequisites: Knowledge of calculus, algebra and solving differential equations.
Theory of Machines, Mechanics of Structures and Mechanics of Machines.

learning_outcomes.text: Understand the specific technical documentation and the theoretical bases on the dynamics of motor vehicles and their main systems and components.

Be able to apply their knowledge and understanding to identify, formulate and solve calculation, design and testing problems of motor vehicles and their main systems using specifically established methods.
Be able to choose and apply relevant analytical and modeling methods in the calculation, design and testing of motor vehicle components.
Be able to apply their knowledge to develop and carry out designs of motor vehicle systems and components that meet specific requirements.
Be able to design and conduct experiments for the characterization of a motor vehicle or one of its main systems, as well as interpret data and draw conclusions.
Be able to combine theory and practice to solve automotive engineering problems.
Work effectively both individually and in a team.
A systematic understanding of the key concepts and aspects of their branch of engineering.
An adequate knowledge of their branch of engineering that includes some knowledge at the forefront of their field.
The ability to apply their knowledge and understanding to identify, formulate and solve engineering problems using established methods.
The ability to choose and apply relevant analytical and modeling methods.
The ability to apply their knowledge to develop and carry out designs that meet specific requirements.
Understanding of different methods and the ability to use them.
The ability to design and conduct experiments, interpret data and draw conclusions.
Technical and laboratory skills.
The ability to select and use appropriate equipment, tools and methods.
The ability to combine theory and practice to solve engineering problems.
The understanding of applicable methods and techniques and their limitations.
Function effectively both individually and as a team.
Demonstrate awareness of the responsibility of engineering practice, its social and environmental impact, and commitment to professional ethics, responsibility and standards of engineering practice.

That students have demonstrated possession and understanding of knowledge in a field of study that builds on general secondary education, and is usually at a level that, while supported by advanced textbooks, also includes aspects involving knowledge from the forefront of their field of study.

That students know how to apply their knowledge to their work or vocation in a professional way and possess the competences that are usually demonstrated by elaborating and defending arguments and solving problems within their field of study.
Ability to solve problems with initiative, decision-making, creativity, critical reasoning and to communicate and transmit knowledge, skills and abilities in the field of Industrial Engineering.
Ability to design a system, component or process in the field of mechanical engineering to meet required specifications.
Knowledge and ability to apply current legislation as well as mandatory specifications, regulations and standards in the field of mechanical engineering.
Knowledge and ability to apply computational and experimental tools for the analysis and quantification of mechanical engineering problems.
Ability to design and conduct experiments and to analyze and interpret the data obtained.
Knowledge and abilities for the calculation, design and testing of machines.

syllabus_topics: Vehicle typology. Chassis and bodywork. Determination of the center of gravity.

assessment_methods.method: Other assessment (Continuous assessment and laboratory practices)

assessment_rules: Students will be evaluated according to Bologna criteria. Specifically, the work developed by the student during the course related to this subject, as well as a final exam, will be individually graded. The content of laboratory practices will be evaluated. A minimum score of 4 out of 10 on the final exam will be required to consider continuous assessment.
